tasks.title: Final Mobile Responsive Design Review and Fix
tasks.description:
Perform a comprehensive review of mobile responsive design and fix any remaining issues:

1. Read and review all responsive CSS files:
   - src/components/Calculator.css
   - src/components/Button.css
   - src/components/Display.css

2. Review and run existing tests:
   - src/components/Calculator.test.tsx
   - src/components/Button.test.tsx
   - src/components/Display.test.tsx
   - Execute: npm test

3. Test responsive behavior by taking screenshots on multiple viewports:
   - Mobile: 375x667 (iPhone SE)
   - Mobile: 414x896 (iPhone XR)
   - Tablet: 768x1024 (iPad)
   - Desktop: 1920x1080

4. Fix any issues found with:
   - Touch target sizes (minimum 44x44px for mobile)
   - Text readability on small screens
   - Layout overflow or clipping on small screens
   - Button spacing and sizing
   - Display text overflow or truncation
   - Calculator container sizing on mobile

5. Update or add tests to cover responsive behavior and ensure test suite passes

6. Take screenshots using Playwright to verify fixes work across all viewport sizes

7. Save screenshots to .eunomia/screenshots/developer/
acceptance_criteria: Calculator renders correctly on mobile devices (375px-414px width)
All interactive elements meet touch-friendly size requirements (44x44px minimum)
Text is readable and properly sized on all screen sizes
Layout adapts properly to tablet (768px) and desktop (1920px) sizes
All unit tests in the test suite pass
Screenshots confirm proper rendering on all tested viewports

tasks.title: Validate Mobile Responsive Design
tasks.description:
Validate that the calculator is fully responsive on mobile devices:

1. Run the complete test suite:
   - Execute: npm test
   - Verify all tests pass, especially responsive tests in:
     * src/components/Calculator.test.tsx
     * src/components/Button.test.tsx
     * src/components/Display.test.tsx

2. Review screenshots in .eunomia/screenshots/developer/ to confirm:
   - Mobile layouts (375px, 414px widths) display correctly
   - Tablet layout (768px) displays correctly
   - Desktop layout (1920px) displays correctly
   - All elements are properly sized and spaced
   - Text is readable on all viewports
   - No layout overflow or clipping issues

3. Verify responsive design criteria:
   - Touch targets are at least 44x44px on mobile
   - Calculator fits within viewport without horizontal scroll
   - Buttons and display scale appropriately

4. If any issues are found, document them clearly with specific failures
acceptance_criteria: All unit tests pass with no failures
Screenshots confirm proper responsive behavior across all viewports
No layout issues on mobile (375px-414px), tablet (768px), or desktop (1920px) viewports
All touch targets meet minimum size requirements
